title: Police cell death in southern Alberta being investigated
article: The death of a 48-year-old man in police custody on a reserve in southern Alberta is being investigated.
The Alberta Serious Incident Response Team says it has been called in to review what happened in a Blood Tribe Police Service cell.
ASIRT spokesman Clif Purvis says the man was believed to be drunk and to have breached a court order when he was arrested on Tuesday.
Purvis says the man was checked by officers in the early hours of June 1 and found to be unresponsive.
The man has not yet been positively identified.
